vibe_rationale: Independent festival running since 2004 with a deep local scene and curated multi-genre stages; narrower than SURPLUS beyond music.
fit_notes: Adult, university-adjacent independent music crowd with real community depth and weak wellness adjacency. Fifteen partners, mostly government and major brands, with no partnership page or contact published. A recovery or wellness space would be additive, and the late-November industry days are a lower-cost entry point. Brazil-based.
